title: Rohini court lawyers stop work over alleged police assault on an advocate

tea.why: The Bar says an advocate was manhandled and assaulted at Mahendra Park police station on Sept 29.
tea.want: Action against the police personnel involved in the alleged assault.
tea.changed: Oct 5: lawyers abstained from judicial work and barred police officials from the Rohini court premises for the day.

summary: Lawyers at Delhi's Rohini district courts abstained from judicial work on October 5 after the Rohini Court Bar Association called a strike over the alleged manhandling and assault of an advocate at Mahendra Park police station on September 29. The Bar also said no police official from any district would be allowed into the court premises, including the Naib Court, that day. Its notice said the executive committee had raised the matter with the joint commissioner of police, the North-West district DCP and the principal district judge before calling the strike.
demands: Action against police personnel over the alleged assault on an advocate
response: No response from Delhi Police is reported in the sources.

updates.text: The Bar Association called a full abstention from work for Oct 5.
Lawyers stayed away from courts and barred police from the premises for the day.
